summary: sync pagination defaults changed from cursor-based (after/"") to page-number (page[number]/page) for all 49 resources.
reason: The generation-time profiler mis-detected Productive's paginator as cursor-based. Productive lists advance with page[number], so the after-cursor extractor never found a cursor and the numeric page fallback (gated on cursorType=="page") never ran — sync stopped after page 1 and left the local SQLite mirror incomplete for larger resources.
validated_outcome: Live sync of time_entries with the fixed binary fetched 7300+ rows across 70+ pages (was capped at ~100 before).
